_why: Phase AM.0 (2026-11-14): the iOS agent's capabilities (verbs/ios/_capabilities.json) as the Mac's applet verbs (portal/applet-verbs.json), so a catalog agent runs on mChatAI+ with the Mac's own steps. `args` renames the iOS argument to the Mac one; `each` names an iOS argument that is a list run as one Mac call per item. A capability with `applet: null` has no Mac verb yet: `missing` says why and which phase adds it. Plan: mchatai_macOS/docs/MAC_AGENT_PORT_PLAN.md.

calendar.agenda._note: The adapter turns the iOS `when` (today, tomorrow, this week) into days ahead.

research.search.missing: Runs in the agent core on both apps (sources/, AgentSources).

research.readItem.missing: Runs in the agent core on both apps.

text.summarize.missing: A model call in the agent core.

web.readPage.missing: The agent's own off-screen reader (AM.3). AI Web's verbs move the person's visible AI Web pane.

agents.create.missing: His own agents, kept on the Mac (AM.5).

app.open.missing: Opens an applet through the Mac's own navigation (AM.5), not a verb.

podcast.createEpisode.missing: PodcastProjectManager has no verb; podcasts.* is open in APPLET_VERB_SCOPING (AM.7).

quiz.create.missing: no Quiznect generator or verb on the Mac (AM.7).

macs.status.missing: this Mac is the Mac; Remote Workbench status is AM.7 (AM.7).

podcast.playEpisode.missing: iOS only for now (Phase FL.10): a companion pack's own episode, quiz set and note sources, shown over the iOS chat.

quiz.openSet.missing: iOS only for now (Phase FL.10): a companion pack's own episode, quiz set and note sources, shown over the iOS chat.

notes.openSource.missing: iOS only for now (Phase FL.10): a companion pack's own episode, quiz set and note sources, shown over the iOS chat.
